authority_invariants: Reserve/receive/verify/seal staging invisible; seal is not committed or query-ready.
SQL commit binds ledger/accounting/outbox atomically; object and SQL transactions separate. Exact durable reconciliation required for ambiguous acknowledgment.
Tenant/source installation/generation/immutable selection/profile/codec/reducer/manifest identity remains explicit. Exact originals and typed projections have different authority.
Current tenant/account/source/purpose/recipient/detail/time/existing-or-future grants and suppression apply to every page and materialization/commit. Unsupported source-purpose remains unavailable.
Authentication completes over a complete declared unit before any plaintext from that unit is visible; byte-range success cannot authenticate a prefix.

Later accepted deletion/revocation must survive restore/rollback/reindex through latest independently current complete suppression journal outside restored lineage. Missing/stale/wrong lineage blocks service.
Source-specific precision/missingness/coverage preserved; no cross-device/source dedup or precedence without reviewed identity/equivalence.
No model execution/provider guarantee, deployment, promotion, region policy or deletion of real state authorized.

state_model.success_receipt: stored reports exact committed original; ready reports specific completed projection/frontier/coverage only; ambiguous state is pending_unknown.
state_model.no_distributed_atomicity: Verified staging objects plus transactional SQL ledger/accounting/outbox and idempotent reconciliation, never SQL/object atomicity promise.
state_model.late_cancel: Committed winner reconciles; separate current authorized erase required.
state_model.restore_service_gate: Current independently authenticated checkpoint + complete matching suppression/revoke journal + replay/read-old compatibility + current grants, then separately qualified promotion.
